create_evolution_trace: create an EvolutionTrace dataclass entry with parent and child metrics to track program evolution
calculate_improvement: calculate the improvement between parent and child program metrics using EvolutionTrace calculate_improvement method
log_evolution_traces: log evolution traces to a JSONL file using EvolutionTracer with configurable buffer size and code inclusion
extract_checkpoint_traces: extract evolution traces from a checkpoint directory and save them as JSONL or JSON format
extract_full_lineage: extract full lineage traces with improvement steps and LLM prompts from a checkpoint directory
